📰 Your Phone's Secret Code for Speed

Modern smartphones achieve incredible performance through sophisticated semiconductor design patterns like DVFS, big.LITTLE, and cache hierarchies. These hardware-software co-design principles enable developers to write code that adapts to dynamic power and performance constraints. Understanding these mechanisms unlocks better mobile application architecture decisions.
